item.title: X outage takes down social media platform
item.description: X suffered a widespread outage early Monday, leaving thousands unable to access the platform.

item.title: Logan Paul sells Pikachu Illustrator trading card for more than $16.4M
item.description: Logan Paul pocked a good chunk of change on Sunday as he sold his coveted Pikachu Illustrator card for more than $16.4 million with Goldin Auctions.

item.title: Navarro promises ‘largest rebate in American history’ as Supreme Court weighs Trump tariffs
item.description: Trump advisor Peter Navarro promises Americans the "biggest rebate" in history while touting a "Goldilocks economy" with easing inflation and growth.

item.title: Wendy's to close hundreds of restaurants as company looks to focus on value to boost sales
item.description: Wendy's planned restaurant closures target underperforming locations in an effort to boost sales and refocus its strategy on everyday value.

item.title: California gas prices surge 40 cents in just 2 weeks as impact of refinery closures weighs
item.description: Refinery closures including Valero's Benicia facility leave California with six operating refineries, driving gas prices to the highest in nation at $4.58 per gallon.

item.title: Dollar Tree makes an upscale play to fuel sales
item.description: Dollar Tree's expansion into wealthier ZIP codes reflects broader retail trend as inflation drives affluent consumers to discount stores for everyday essentials.

item.title: GOP senators warn Bessent against ‘shell game’ proposals in Lukoil divestment talks
item.description: Republican Sens. Tim Sheehy, Steve Daines and John Barrasso urged Treasury to ensure Lukoil’s foreign assets are permanently divested from Russia.

item.title: How to avoid tax scams this filing season
item.description: Taxpayers can protect themselves from scams with the knowledge that the IRS always contacts taxpayers by mail first, and never demands immediate payment via specific methods.

item.title: Americans see bigger tax refunds so far this year as filing season begins at a slower pace
item.description: Americans are getting bigger tax refunds this year, with average refunds jumping to $2,290 - up 10.9% from last year, according to the latest IRS data.

item.title: Salmon sold at BJ’s Wholesale Club recalled over potential listeria contamination
item.description: The FDA announced a recall of Wellsley Farms Farm-Raised Atlantic Salmon sold at BJ's locations in seven states due to potential listeria contamination.
